name: server_silent
_thresholds: the outage freezes every remote mech on the client for the 6 s it takes to give up -- the point of the scenario, not a smoothness bug
_comment: T558: the link goes dark for 16 s mid-match with no close (the proxy holds every byte), as when a player's wifi drops or the server hangs. Over WebSocket TCP never tells the client, so only the T214 silence check can: no snapshot for 6 s -> leave for the title. peer_closed: every client printed its server_lost_check on the title (expect_server_lost). Before T558 the check was ENet-only and dead since T422: the client sat in the frozen match until its run deadline.
